label: ready-for-agent
lessons: Two-axis self-review caught a real contract bug (fake project() returning {lng,lat} instead of {x,y}) before human review - the second axis earns its keep.
Repo post-commit hook (graft build) writes to relative path graft/last-deep-build.log and fails inside worktrees; cosmetic but noisy - fix by anchoring to git rev-parse --show-toplevel.
Commit messages with apostrophes broke shell heredoc quoting; use git commit -F with a message file.
